notes: WorldMarketToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 WORLD once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. Transfers use standard ERC-20 behavior with no fees. There are no administrative powers or externally callable mint or burn functions. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
